author: Daqing Chen
selection: First 200 worksheet rows with non-cancelled invoice, positive quantity <=1000 and price rounded to positive integer pence. Customer ID, country, description and timestamps excluded. Prices are GBP; Decimal rounding to nearest penny removes XLSX floating-point representation noise.
limitation: Small ordered sample, not statistically representative. Replay and lost-ACK failures are injected; the dataset does not contain retry or incident ground truth.
